speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Early Disseminated Syphilis (Secondary Syphilis) with Reactive Arthritis.

The combination of a systemic inflammatory response (elevated WBC), history of knee pain, and specifically the "painless violaceous vesiculopustular lesions" on the palms and wrists is highly characteristic of the hand-foot syndrome seen in secondary syphilis. The wrist findings are likely secondary reactive arthritis or septic-like inflammation caused by Treponema pallidum.

Please confirm if you have noticed any other generalized rash, particularly on your trunk, or any mucous membrane sores. I will now order a RPR/VDRL and confirmatory TPPA test.
